description: What is true in WordPress today, in one dated call: the current versions of WordPress, PHP, Gutenberg, WP-CLI and the MCP Adapter, the next release with its stage and date, and what changed recently with what to do about it (deprecations, new APIs, security, AI and MCP). Your training data is older than WordPress: call this once before writing or reviewing WordPress code, or when a version question comes up. Pass `since` with your training cutoff to get every change after it, or `area` for one subject.

area.description: Only changelog entries for this area

limit.description: Maximum changelog entries (default 8, or 50 with area or since)

since.description: Only changes on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. your training cutoff

name: wp_today
title: WordPress today
